summary: Frontend-only re-verification of the receipt JPEG export padding/clipping fix on the preview app (admin 9999999999/Admin@123, existing collection LFC-2608-1A2D1, read-only). Verified by inspecting the real downloaded raster (PIL + ink bounding-box analysis), not just the DOM. RESULT: the MEDIUM defect reported in iteration_14 is FIXED. Details: (1) Download -> suggested_filename 'Co-Daily-Collection-LFC-2608-1A2D1.jpg', magic ff d8 ff e0 (JFIF), EOI ff d9, 114,694 bytes, PIL JPEG 1188x1605 RGB. (2) Padding measured from the ink bounding box (72,109)-(1113,1493) at scale 3 => left 24.0 CSS px, right 24.7, top 36.3, bottom 37.0 - all >= 20px requirement. DOM confirms .receipt-print-content padding 24px / margin -24px -24px 0, vendor label left gap 23.6px, thank-you bottom gap 41.3px. (3) Thank-you line fully inside the raster: bottom crop visually inspected - 'Thank you for your payment.' incl. the trailing period and descenders is complete with ~37 CSS px of white below (previously last dark row was 1409/1410). (4) Only popup content captured: image contains brand, RECEIPT NO. + number, plain amount '500', VENDOR/PAYMENT MODE/RECEIVED AT/COLLECTED BY/REMARKS, dashed rules and thank-you line; no dashboard, backdrop, close button or action buttons. (5) No rupee glyph / 'Rs' / 'INR' anywhere inside .receipt-print-content ([data-testid=receipt-amount] = '500'). (6) Long content: injected a 137-char remarks string (client-side DOM only, no data change) -> content grew to 577px and wrapped to 3 lines; exported JPEG 1185x1719 with padding left 23.7 / right 24.0 / top 36.0 / bottom 37.0 CSS px and the thank-you line intact. (7) Share: with navigator.share/canShare stubbed, app calls share with title 'Co. Daily Collection receipt' and files[0] = {name .jpg, type image/jpeg, size 116,566}. (8) Print: window.open stubbed -> opened with target '_blank', single injected whose blob: URL fetches back as image/jpeg 114,899 bytes magic ff d8 ff e0 (no receipt HTML markup written), focus() and print() both invoked (second timeout retry path works). With window.open forced to null the fallback downloads the identical .jpg. (9) Mobile 390x844: no horizontal overflow (documentElement.scrollWidth 390 == innerWidth 390), dialog 348x703 and the last action button bottom at 753px are inside the viewport; mobile export 1020x1605 with identical 24/36/37 padding and unclipped thank-you line. (10) Chart Y-axis apostrophe corruption is gone - ticks now render 'Rs. 0.004k' via tickFormatter `Rs. ${value/1000}k` with no stray glyph. Export error element never appeared (0 occurrences) and no console errors other than the two pre-existing 401s from the pre-login /api/auth/me probe.

design_issues.screen: Dashboard 'Collections trend' chart Y-axis (cosmetic, pre-existing area)
issues: Tick labels now read 'Rs. 0.004k' and wrap onto two lines ('Rs.' above '0.004k') because the label is wider than the default YAxis width; also inconsistent with the metric cards which use the rupee glyph. Suggest keeping the rupee glyph (or dropping the prefix) and widening YAxis, plus avoiding the '0.004k' form for small values.

critical_code_review_comments: Padding fix is sound: .receipt-print-content { padding: 24px; margin: -24px -24px 0 } keeps the on-screen layout identical (negative margin cancels the visual growth inside .receipt-dialog's 30px padding) while giving html2canvas a padded box - verified by raster measurement.
printReceipt now has both onload and a 1600ms fallback timeout guarded by printStarted, so print fires exactly once - verified via stubbed window.open (focus+print both true, single call).
runImageAction console.error's the underlying error while showing the friendly message - diagnosability restored.

Optional hardening: html2canvas height is still derived from the element box; if a future receipt has fractional height the 24px bottom padding absorbs rounding, but passing height: Math.ceil(scrollHeight) would make it deterministic.

success_rate.frontend: 6/6 requested verification items pass; 0 functional defects; 1 cosmetic chart-axis label suggestion

seed_data_creation: None. Read-only (admin login + opening existing receipts). Long-remarks case simulated by client-side DOM text replacement only. Artifacts in /tmp: it15_receipt.jpg, it15_receipt_long.jpg, it15_receipt_mobile.jpg (+ generated crops).
test_credentials: Admin 9999999999 / Admin@123 (worked; admin form is the default mode on the login page, no need to click the administrator link).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression recipe: login admin -> click first [data-testid^=view-receipt-] -> page.expect_download on [data-testid=receipt-download-button] -> save to /tmp and run `python /tmp/analyze_jpeg.py <file>` which prints magic bytes, PIL size and the ink bounding box / per-side padding in CSS px (expect ~24 left/right, ~36 top, ~37 bottom at scale 3). Share/Print verified by stubbing navigator.share and window.open in page.evaluate. Receipt JPEG export is now fully verified - no open defects.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous clipping RCA (unpadded captured node -> html2canvas rounded height cut the final line) is resolved: padding on the captured node both removes the flush-to-edge look and absorbs the height rounding, so the thank-you line ends ~111 device px (37 CSS px) above the raster bottom.
